disclaimer: These maps are relative model footprints from an unvalidated screening ensemble. They are not measurements of lead in air, soil, or dust, and they are not concentrations, doses, or a health determination. Follow instructions from the U.S. Army, U.S. EPA, Iowa HHS, and local emergency managers.
narrative: Fairfield is 65 km west-northwest of the installation centroid (292°). The relative airborne footprint on this run lies mostly to the southeast of the installation centroid. No ensemble member placed an airborne particle in the Fairfield cell or the eight cells around it. The nearest cell with any member is about 62 km from Fairfield. Surface-deposition overlap in the Fairfield cell: 0 of 18 members, using the assumed removal parameters. About 23% of particles left the map window during the 8-hour simulation, so the drawn footprint is cut off at the border. Overlap counts model scenarios. It is not a measurement of lead and not a concentration.
